railPr.markDoneConfirmBody: The implementation confirmed that no code changes are needed. The specs will move to Done and the no-change worktree will be cleaned up.
railPr.refineConfirmBody: The no-change result will be closed and the specs will return to the backlog so you can refine them. The run logs remain available.
railPr.retryPushVerified: Push verified · commit {{sha}} is in the PR
railPr.commitAlreadyVerified: Commit {{sha}} is already verified in the PR

railPr.checkoutTooltip: Check out {{branch}} in the main project folder
railPr.checkoutFailed: Could not check out the PR branch
railPr.checkoutDirtyTitle: Checkout blocked to protect your changes
railPr.checkoutDirtyBody: The main project folder has uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them, then retry. Nothing was changed.
railPr.checkoutSafetyUnknownTitle: Checkout paused because safety could not be verified
railPr.checkoutSafetyUnknownBody: Specrails could not read the main project folder’s Git status. Nothing was released or changed. Retry after Git is available.
railPr.checkoutNotDeliverableTitle: This PR branch is not the preserved implementation
railPr.checkoutNotDeliverableBody: No exact delivery commit has been verified yet. Inspect or recover the local result instead.
railPr.inspectLocalResultTooltip: Reveal the preserved isolated worktree and copy its path
railPr.localResultUnavailableHere: No recoverable worktree is available on this computer. Review the run log from the machine where it executed.
railPr.recoverAndRetryConfirmTitle: Commit and push the preserved result?
railPr.recoverAndRetryConfirmBody: Specrails will use only the isolated worktree or recorded fast-forward branch for {{branch}}. It will commit deliverable files if needed, then push the exact commit only if the PR is still open on the expected head and base. Your main project folder and its uncommitted changes will not be touched.
railPr.recoverAndRetryVerified: Recovered commit {{sha}} is verified in the PR
railPr.recheckRecoveryConfirmBody: Specrails will rescan this clone’s delivery-owned worktree, branch, refs, reflogs, and orphan Git objects for {{branch}}. If it proves one result, it may commit isolated changes and retry the exact push. Your main project folder will not be touched.
railPr.recoveryUnavailable: Recovery could not be verified on this computer
railPr.recoveryUnavailableBody: Specrails could not safely prove one delivery-owned result in this clone. Nothing was changed or removed. Inspect the stage detail and run logs. If the run executed on another computer, open Specrails there, then check again.
railPr.discardTooltip: Close the delivery and return its tickets to Specs; changed local work is preserved
railPr.verifyPrTooltip: Verify the exact commit in GitHub and check whether the PR is merged
railPr.checkMergeTooltip: Ask GitHub whether the PR has been merged
railPr.commitMissingRetry: The delivery commit is no longer in the PR. Retry push is available again.
railPr.mergedToast: PR merged — tickets moved to Done
railPr.discardedToast: PR discarded — tickets returned to Specs
railPr.decisionPending: This rail has a pending PR decision — create, publish or discard it before relaunching
railPr.discardConfirmBody: The PR will be closed without deleting its remote branch. Only SpecRails-owned local branches and worktrees that are still at their recorded commit will be removed; anything changed will be preserved with a warning. The tickets will return to the Specs backlog. Removed local resources cannot be recovered.
railPr.implementationFailedDiscardBody: The card will be cleared and its tickets will return to Specs. Local work and branches will be kept for inspection. Only resources proven safe to clean up may be removed.
railPr.dismissConfirmBody: This follow-up card will be cleared. Its owned worktree will be removed only if it is still safe; otherwise it will be preserved with a warning. The existing PR, its branch, and review state will remain unchanged.
railPr.discardLocalConfirmBody: The recoverable local iteration will be removed only if it is still safe; if it changed, it will be preserved with a warning. Any existing PR and its branch will remain unchanged. A removed result cannot be recovered.
railPr.mergeLocalTooltip: Merge the delivered branches into {{base}} in your local checkout (no GitHub needed)
railPr.mergeLocalConfirmBody: The delivered branches will be merged into {{base}} in your local checkout. Your checkout must be on {{base}} with a clean working tree.
railPr.mergeLocalBlockedDirty: Cannot integrate: your working tree on {{base}} has uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them, then retry.
railPr.mergeLocalBlockedBranch: Cannot integrate: your checkout is on {{current}}, not {{base}}. Check out {{base}}, then retry.
railPr.cleanupIncompleteHint: Local recovery data was preserved. Inspect these details before removing anything manually.
railPr.safetyArchiveHint: Temporary workspace files were preserved outside the PR as a precaution. You can inspect or remove them manually.
